rows.claim: If callers pass a header row, the new `totals_row` will try to `float()` the header text and fail.
rows.evidence: No tool output shows this. The agent never ran totals_row on header-containing data. The test failure output for test_first_row_is_header was truncated and only showed an AssertionError, not a ValueError from float(). The claim is a reasonable inference from the code (`float(r[col])` over all rows), but it was not verified. Also, in the test, the header row is ["a", 1], and numeric column 1 holds an int, so it wouldn't fail there. The claim is only conditional on real header text in numeric columns.
